evidence: Has the Wallet label and directly modifies src/wallet/ wallet database migration and error handling.
rationale: Prevents potential wallet database corruption and data loss during legacy-to-SQLite wallet migration. As noted in the description, MigrateToSQLite previously deleted the original BerkeleyDB database prior to verifying SQLite database creation, and leftover journal files could cause SQLite to roll stale pages into the migrated database, corrupting it.
